title: NDVI basics — single-band NDVI product (D7 foundry scene: water / vegetation / urban / soil / forest / shadow)

assertions.derivation: D7 bundle grid contract: sicnu_generate_samples (tools/sample_foundry) emits the Lab profile as 256x256 at 30 m in EPSG:32648 (UTM 48N); a submission on another grid is not comparable to the known answer. (Calibrated to the foundry scene; the repo data/labs/grading copy tracks the D4/D1 fixture.)
NDVI=(N-R)/(N+R) is bounded by [-1,1] for non-negative reflectance (KNOWN_ANSWER_MATRIX spectral family). Catches display stretches (x100+50) and unit slips.

Measured over the foundry seed-42 Lab scene (class map + reflectance table water/vegetation/urban/bare soil/forest/shadow with ±0.02 portable noise, NDVI via safeDiv on float32 red/nir): full-scene mean≈0.4521261, population sigma≈0.5084647 with 131 denom-zero NaN pixels (131/65536≈0.200%). Mean tolerance 0.01; sigma window [0.48, 0.54] absorbs float32 rounding across compilers. (Calibrated to the foundry scene; the repo copy tracks the D4/D1 fixture.)

The foundry landsat_sample declares no band NoData; rs:spectral_index writes NaN (declared NoData) where red+nir==0 after float32 noise — observed 131/65536≈0.200%. min_ratio 0.001 catches a product that forgot to mask those pixels (ratio 0); max_ratio 0.05 catches over-masking.
The scene's dominant states (water/urban/soil vs vegetation/forest) put the NDVI histogram in two separated lobes; bimodality catches stretches that smear the classes.
